prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1457; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, but you can use the claim file reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?

A: It was on a two-lane road in Katy, Texas, near a shopping center. Traffic was slow that afternoon.

Q: And what were you doing at the time?

A: I was driving home from work. I was going maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour because of the traffic backing up.

Q: Describe what happened.

A: The other car crossed into my lane. I tried to swerve, but there wasn't much room. We hit front to front, though it was a light impact. My airbags didn't deploy.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any injuries right after the collision?

A: Not right away. I was shaken up, but I got out of the car on my own. By that evening my right knee was swollen and I couldn't bend it well.

Q: Have you seen a doctor about the knee?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic specialist.

Q: Have you had any prior problems with that knee?

A: Nothing serious. I had some soreness years ago from running, but nothing that stopped me from working.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm still having trouble with stairs and driving for long periods. I'd like to be kept updated on the claim.

Q: Understood. This concludes the statement. Thank you.
